newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Halla wins $90 mln Cyprus ship order.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Halla wins $90 mln Cyprus ship order.

text.p: South Korea's Halla Heavy Industries Co said on Monday it had recently won a $90 million order from Reederei "Nord" Klaus E Oldendorff Ltd of Cyprus to build two oil product tankers.
The two 105,000-deadweight-tonne oil product tankers are scheduled to be delivered between late 1998 and early 1999, a statement from Halla said.
Halla Heavy is one of South Korea's major shipbuilding companies and a member firm of the Halla Group, whose flagship unit is Halla Cement Manufacturing Corp.
